credentials.description: Google OAuth access token for Gmail read and Calendar events read.
credentials.obtain: Generate an OAuth access token with the minimum Gmail and Calendar read scopes required by the agent.
credentials.obtain_instructions: Create or reuse a Google OAuth client, complete user consent, and store only the resulting access token placeholder here. Verify the token has read-only Gmail messages access and Calendar events read access before approval.

credentials.description: Discord bot token used to send channel messages.
credentials.obtain: Create a Discord application bot and copy its bot token.
credentials.obtain_instructions: In the Discord Developer Portal, create or select an application, add a bot, reset/copy the bot token, invite the bot to the target server with channel message send permission, and approve the value in Agent Vault.

credentials.description: Telegram bot token substituted into Bot API paths.
credentials.obtain: Create a Telegram bot with BotFather and copy the token.
credentials.obtain_instructions: Chat with @BotFather, run /newbot or /token for an existing bot, copy the token, and approve it in Agent Vault. Agents use the __bot_token__ placeholder; Agent Vault substitutes the real token only while forwarding.
